sloka: सुमन्त्रः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तुष्टाव जगतीपतिम् ।यथा नन्दति तेजस्वी सागरो भास्करोदये ।प्रीतह् प्रीतेन मनसा तथानन्दघनः स्वतः ॥२-१४-४७॥
transliteration: sumantraḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā tuṣṭāva jagatīpatim ।yathā nandati tejasvī sāgaro bhāskarodaye ।prītah prītena manasā tathānandaghanaḥ svataḥ ॥2-14-47॥

translations.english: Just as the mighty ocean rejoices at sunrise, the inherently cheerful Sumantra became delighted to see the king.
